item.title: Drop the « Images externes » setting: images always load, the choice moves to Expérimental (#902)
item.body:
Closes #902
Claim: cloud/exp-a-sonnet
Author model: sonnet-5.5 (cloud/exp-a-sonnet)
Reviewer model: opus-5.5 (cloud/r984-opus-delta; round 1 cloud/r984-opus)

**Problem.** Réglages › Général carried an « Images externes » picker (Jamais / Wi-Fi uniquement / Toujours, default Wi-Fi). Legacy has no such setting: it forces `display_images = "yes"` (`HFRplusAppDelegate.m:117-118` @ 87fe0d1c).

**Change** (operator decisions of 2026-11-14 on #902).
- The picker leaves the main Réglages and `GeneralSettingsModel.imageLoading` is removed.
- Images always load, cellular included: `ReaderSettings.autoLoad(store:)` returns `.always` unless the experimental choice is on. The `display_images` default is now `yes`.
- The choice moves to Réglages › Expérimental › « Chargement des images » (`imageLoadingChoice`, now listed): once the switch is on, a Toujours / Wi-Fi uniquement / Jamais (au toucher) picker shows under it and writes `display_images`. Code in `App/SwiftHFR/Experimental/ImageLoadingChoice/`, marked `// EXPERIMENTAL(imageLoadingChoice, #902)`.
- Old values: the key is kept; a value an earlier build stored (`no`, `wifi`) is ignored while the option is off (images show after the update) and becomes the picker's value if the option is switched on. No migration, no crash.
- Policy C privacy parts (cookie-less client, no private hosts) untouched; `ImageDecision` unchanged.
- ADR 0013 row of `display_images` updated.

**Tests** (fail without the change): `theImageModeIsAlwaysUnlessTheExperimentalChoiceIsOn` (stored `never` + option off → images auto-load on cellular; option on → the stored mode applies), `theModelNoLongerWritesDisplayImages`, `privateHostsStayBlockedWhateverTheSetting` (option on, every mode), `ImageAutoLoad(setting: nil) == .always`, `SettingKey.displayImages` default `.always` (HFRKit: `swift test --filter HFRStorageTests` green here, 515 tests); the Experimental tests now expect the option listed under « Chargement des images ». SwiftLint `--strict` clean on the touched files. App tests not run here (Linux).

**Device-check points**
- Réglages › Général has no « Images externes » row.
- Cellular (Network Link Conditioner / Wi-Fi off): third-party images load without a tap.
- Update from a build with « Jamais » stored: images show.
- Réglages › Expérimental › Chargement des images: switch on shows the picker (default Toujours); Jamais puts placeholders back, Wi-Fi uniquement loads only on Wi-Fi; switch off returns to always.

### Ledger

```gap-edit
GAP-056
SwiftHFR final: Policy C: cookie-less, no private hosts; images always load, cellular included, as legacy (no setting in Réglages). Behind Réglages › Expérimental › « Chargement des images » (#902), off by default: a Toujours / Wi-Fi uniquement / Jamais (au toucher) picker (Wi-Fi auto and cellular on tap; never behind a tap).
Lot/Feat: LOT-083, LOT-107, FEAT-011, #902
```

```ledger-note
GAP-LEGACY-VS-SWIFT.md, GAP-230 (« not gated by "Images externes" ») and UX decision 7 (line ~293, « Image policy C (Wi-Fi auto, cellular on tap) … replace "always load" »): after #902 there is no « Images externes » setting and images always load; policy C's Wi-Fi/tap modes exist only behind Réglages › Expérimental › « Chargement des images ». Reword both by hand.
```

Round 1 fixes (head below): docs amended (FEAT-011, LOT-060/071/083/107, FEAT-014), picker order Toujours / Wi-Fi uniquement / Jamais, a why-comment on the raw store read, and the weak test replaced by `theGeneralModelLeavesDisplayImagesAlone`. Kept on purpose: the picker starts from a stored `display_images` (the key is kept, as the issue says).

comments.body:
Agent: cloud/r984-opus (claude-opus-5-5)

**Adversarial review (opus, cloud/r984-opus, round 1): REQUEST CHANGES** — head 6db6a80a294ee7b143bf6fac9e36abef047accf3

1. **Medium — the docs no longer match the code.** Each spot below still describes the old picker in Réglages › Général, with Wi-Fi as the default:
   - `docs/features/FEAT-011.md:10,22` and its row in `docs/FEATURES.md:60`.
   - `docs/lots/LOT-083-topic-reader.md:80`: "default `wifiOnly`".
   - `docs/lots/LOT-060-settings-store.md:71`: "defaults to `wifi` … set in Réglages › Général, LOT-107".
   - `docs/lots/LOT-071-third-party-services.md:145-146`.
   - `docs/lots/LOT-107-image-loading-setting.md:12`: names `GeneralSettingsModel.imageLoading`, which this PR removes.
   - `docs/features/FEAT-014.md:19`: "the 'Images externes' setting".

   Scenario: the next agent reads LOT-083 or FEAT-011, believes cellular images wait for a tap, and "fixes" the code back. Fix: update these docs (FEAT-011 gets a dated amendment pointing to #902).
2. **Medium — the `### Ledger` section covers GAP-056's text cell only.**
   - GAP-056 keeps "UX change | new UX: operator | b·needed", although the default is legacy behaviour again.
   - GAP-230 still says "not gated by 'Images externes'".
   - UX decision 7 (`GAP-LEGACY-VS-SWIFT.md:293`) still says "policy C (Wi-Fi auto, cellular on tap) replace 'always load'".

   Fix: add the cells for GAP-056's last columns to its `gap-edit`, a `gap-edit` for GAP-230, and a `ledger-note` for decision 7.
3. **Low — `GeneralSettingsModelTests.swift:110` `theModelNoLongerWritesDisplayImages` cannot fail.** The old model only read the key in `init`, and `didSet` does not fire there. So the test also passes on `origin/dev-swift`, which goes against "shown to fail without the change". Fix: drop it, or test something that changed (for example, that the picker writes `display_images`).
4. **Low — a value stored by an earlier build comes back.** `ImageLoadingChoice.swift:37` starts the picker from the stored `display_images`. A tester who chose « Jamais » in a beta, then turns the option on, gets « Jamais », not the « Toujours » default the decision names. Fix: confirm with the operator that this is intended (the PR body says it is). Otherwise, start from `.always` when the option was never turned on.
5. **Detail — the picker order does not match its own description.** `ImageDisplayMode.allCases` shows Toujours / Jamais / Wi-Fi uniquement. The explanation (`ExperimentalFeature.swift:84`) and #902 list a different order. Fix: give the picker an explicit list `[.always, .wifiOnly, .never]`.
6. **Detail — the reader reads the switch from the raw store.** `ImageLoadingChoice.autoLoad` (`ImageLoadingChoice.swift:14`) skips the `isListed` guard of `ExperimentalSettings.isOn`. If the option is hidden again, the reader will still obey it. Fix: a one-line *why* comment (it is called off the main actor), or also check `ExperimentalFeature.imageLoadingChoice.isListed`.

Checked: diff and #902 body read; HFRKit `SettingKeyTests|SettingScopeTests` pass (30 tests); `swiftlint lint --strict` clean on every touched file, no line over 140 columns; compiler-rigour read (no default MainActor isolation, `@State` set up in `init`, two-parameter `onChange`, `isOn` reads the observed `stored`); grep of `App/` and `docs/` for removed API finds nothing left; tests 1–2 fail on the old defaults, test 3 does not.

Agent: cloud/r984-opus-delta (opus, claude-opus-5-5)

**Adversarial review (opus, cloud/r984-opus-delta, delta 2d6fe1e)**: APPROVE — head 2d6fe1e

Round 1 findings, checked on the delta:
- (1) Stale docs: fixed. FEAT-011 has an amendment, and LOT-060, LOT-071, LOT-083, LOT-107 and FEAT-014 have superseded notes.
- (2) Ledger: the GAP-056 `gap-edit` and a `ledger-note` covering GAP-230 and UX decision 7 are acceptable.
- (3) Test: `theGeneralModelLeavesDisplayImagesAlone` fails on `origin/dev-swift`, by reading the code. There, `ReaderSettings.autoLoad` maps the stored `"no"` to `.onTap`, so the second `#expect` (`== .always`) is red.
- (4) Stored value comes back when the option is turned on: kept on purpose. It is consistent with "key kept" (issue #902).
- (5) Picker order: fixed with the explicit order Toujours / Wi-Fi uniquement / Jamais.
- (6) Raw store read: fixed. The why-comment is added, and its claim holds: `ExperimentalFeature.imageLoadingChoice.isListed == true` (`ExperimentalFeature.swift:42`), so the raw read and `ExperimentalSettings` agree.

New findings:
1. Basse. `App/SwiftHFR/Messages/AvatarStore.swift:12` and `App/SwiftHFRTests/Messages/AvatarStoreTests.swift:98` still say "The "Images externes" setting…", a setting that no longer exists. Fix: reword both to "the image-loading choice (Réglages › Expérimental, #902)".
2. Basse. `Packages/HFRKit/Sources/HFRStorage/Settings/SettingKey.swift:157` says "Legacy forced `yes` at every launch … and so does the app now". The app does not force anything at launch: `yes` is only the default, and a stored value is kept. Fix: "defaults to `yes`, so images always load unless the experimental option is on".
3. Détail. `GeneralSettingsModelTests.swift:111-117`: the first `#expect` also passes on dev-swift, because `didSet` only writes on a change. Only the reader `#expect` proves the change. Acceptable; the test name could say so.

Verified: diff 6db6a80..2d6fe1e and the PR body's Ledger section read; delta checked against dev-swift code; swiftlint --strict passes. App tests not run (needs a Mac).

Author note: new findings 1 and 2 applied as comment-only changes in 93e86ed7 (no code change); 3 left.
